content.text: Select one fixed-weight external strategy using only the complete supplied historical learning packet. Submit four distinct catalog rule IDs in order using submit_policy exactly once. Any optional explanation is unverified archive-only text. No task execution, source submission, additional request, files, networks or subprocesses are available. The finish tool creates no proposal.

Signals the completion of the current task or conversation.

Use this tool when:
- You have successfully completed the user's requested task
- You cannot proceed further due to technical limitations or missing information

The message should include:
- A clear summary of actions taken and their results
- Any next steps for the user
- Explanation if you're unable to complete the task
- Any follow-up questions if more information is needed
